newsitem.title: USA: Seacor to buy back stock and notes.
newsitem.headline: Seacor to buy back stock and notes.

text.p: Seacor Holdings Inc said Monday its board had authorized the repurchase of up to $35 million of common stock and 5-3/8 percent convertible subordinated notes due Nov 15, 2006.
It said the amount may be increased to as much as $50 million under certain circumstances.
Seacor said the repurchase of stock or notes, or both, will be made through the open market or privately negotiated transactions.
It said the deals will be carried out from time to time, subject to applicable law and for amounts and prices determined to be appropriate under the circumstances.
Seacor operates a diversified fleet of over 300 marine vessels used to support offshore oil and gas exploration and development in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico, the North Sea and offshore West Africa.
It also provides environmental services domestically and internationally, including marine oil spill response, training, and consulting.
